source_snapshot.procedure: Use BMC Web Security and access > Certificates to generate a CSR and check CSR type.
source_snapshot.criteria: Check CSR type on BMC Web.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 5 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; generates a CSR and reads type/country, noting key/request state and production-overwrite risk.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires exact slot/profile, key lifecycle, private-key protection, PKCS#10 parsing and final-state recovery.

old_problem: 'CSR type' was undefined and generation may create or replace private-key/request state. Exact slot, PKCS#10 profile, overwrite behavior and final-state plan were missing, but can be supplied as controlled project configuration.
disposition_reason: RFC 2986 defines a certification request as signed subject/public-key/attribute data, and OpenSSL can parse and verify PKCS#10 without private-key export. ED-04/15/20 permit the product-specific slot, key/signature algorithms and DN/SAN profile as project inputs. One approved generation plus before/after slot metadata and secure public-CSR validation resolves review semantics without guessing or exposing secrets.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2236, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2237 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00019-V001 / c310670e8bff763b was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Bind exact BMC/WebUI certificate slot and inventory active certificate, pending CSR and non-secret key metadata before generation.
Define whether 'type' is PKCS#10/container, vendor selector, key/signature algorithm or a required combination; sign the key size and DN/SAN/country field matrix.
Prove whether generation creates, reuses or replaces key/request state and establish backup, overwrite and independent certificate-access recovery.
Generate exactly once after authorization, capture only public CSR/slot/UI metadata and never export or log private key material.
Parse PEM/DER PKCS#10 structure, signature verification, public-key/signature algorithms, subject and extensions using a trusted parser; UI country alone cannot pass.
Confirm only intended pending-request/key metadata changed, then retain or clean up under the signed final-state plan; no automatic regeneration.
No login, CSR/key generation, overwrite, cleanup, retry, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: BMC Web CSR generation and approved PKCS#10 profile validation
test_case.purpose: Verify that the intended BMC certificate slot generates one syntactically valid CSR with the approved type, algorithms and subject/SAN profile without exposing private key material or disturbing active management certificates.
required_package: BMC/WebUI and exact certificate-slot identity plus existing non-secret state
Approved CSR container/vendor type, key/signature algorithm/size and DN/SAN/country profile
Key create/reuse/replace semantics, backup/overwrite/final-state policy and recovery
Protected WebUI access, secure public-CSR storage and trusted PKCS#10 parser
test_case.test_command: After slot/profile and one-generation authorization, capture non-secret before-state, populate only approved public fields, generate one CSR, preserve its public artifact/hash and WebUI status, parse/verify PKCS#10 structure, algorithms, subject and extensions, compare before/after slot metadata, and apply the signed final-state plan without private-key export or retry.
test_case.expected_result: One valid CSR is generated in the correct slot; its signature verifies and all approved type/container, public-key/signature algorithm, size, DN/SAN/country fields match; only intended request/key metadata changes, management access remains healthy, and final state matches policy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact slot identity, signed profile, structurally verified public PKCS#10 and approved before/after key-state behavior. Downloadable PEM, country field or UI success alone is insufficient. Wrong slot, unexpected overwrite, parse/signature/profile mismatch, private-key exposure or access degradation is FAIL. Missing bindings blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until slot, profile, key lifecycle, backup/overwrite, secure storage, final state and recovery are signed.
One generation only; never expose/export private keys, credentials or sensitive local paths.
Stop on ambiguous slot, overwrite warning outside plan, unexpected certificate/key replacement, parser mismatch or management-access fault.
No automatic regeneration or cleanup that destroys evidence.
expected_evidence: Redacted before/after certificate, pending-CSR and key metadata
Approved type/algorithm/subject/SAN matrix and UI input record
Public CSR hash plus secret-safe PKCS#10 parse/signature verification output
No-private-key audit, management health, final state and recovery record
test_case.recovery: On wrong slot, overwrite or access anomaly, stop and preserve public/non-secret evidence; do not regenerate. Use the pre-approved certificate backup and independent management path to restore the signed active certificate/request state.
